items.title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Faces Mortgage Bond Return Risk From AI Refinancing
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) and other mortgage bond investors are assessing how the rapid use of AI in mortgage refinancing could affect income from mortgage-backed securities. Mortgage lenders are using AI tools to speed up refinancing decisions, which can change repayment timelines for home loans that back these securities. Faster refinancing activity can alter cash flow patterns for institutional investors that hold mortgage-backed securities, including large banks and asset managers. The...
